characters.story: A tree stands; walls rise round it; it is pressed flat inside them.
A bowl rises; water fills it and spills over the far rim.
Worms breed in a shut bowl, swarm up and pour out.
characters.sentence:
What you leave
shut goes bad

characters.story: Four beams rise as the well's frame; the water in the middle ripples on every beat.
characters.sentence:
The town changes;
the well stays

characters.story: A sprout stands buried to its tip; it pushes up through the ground in three strains, then lies down as the character.
Two lines rise; between them a moon goes from new to full and back, then sets into them; a heart is drawn beside it.
